images.screen: A · 적는다 — 스물세 번째 낱말을 적는 동안 창밖의 강이 지워진다
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Landscape 16:9 screenshot of a quiet literary game about the last speaker of a dying language. Top-down view of a dim wooden desk under lamplight holding two sheets of textured hand-made mulberry paper. Left sheet: a dictionary page titled in bold serif, entries of invented words with part-of-speech tags and one-line definitions, the older entries fading grey, the newest entry being written with a blinking caret and a real calligraphy brush resting at the end of the line, a small ink-wash sketch of stones and flowing water below it, a faint red square seal, and a thin progress bar. Right sheet: a sumi-e ink-wash landscape of a mountain village seen through a window, thatched houses, straight rising smoke, two small figures, a river in the foreground dissolving into speckled erosion as if being erased, a red annotation beside it, and a list of forgotten things struck through in red. Korean UI: "솔매 말 사전", "탈미", "잊혀지는 중". Monochrome sumi ink and warm paper, one vermilion accent, soft vignette. Text constraints: the counter under the progress bar reads exactly "적은 낱말 23"; the struck-through forgotten list on the right sheet names only things of the world outside (e.g. 돌담, 제사 노래, 마을 이름) plus one new unstruck item "강", and never repeats a dictionary word.

images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Landscape 16:9 screenshot of the final beat of a literary game about the last speaker of a dying language. Same desk and two sheets of mulberry paper. Left: the dictionary page is densely filled in two columns of small invented words and short definitions fading from grey to black, and below them a centred serif prompt asks for the last word, the word for oneself, with a single empty ruled line and a tall blinking caret. The progress bar is almost full, a vermilion seal stamped nearby. Right: the ink-wash window landscape has been almost entirely erased to blank pale paper with light falling snow; only one small ink house with a single warmly lit window and a bare sapling remain on a faint horizon line. Beneath, a short list of lost things struck through in red and one remaining line. Korean UI: "마지막 낱말", "남은 것", "나". Near-empty, hushed, pale paper white, sumi black and one warm window glow, soft vignette. Text constraints: the dictionary page is titled "솔매 말 사전" and every headword is an invented word written in Hangul (like 나르, 제온, 하듬, 탈미); no Latin-alphabet or romanized words anywhere.
